definition_en: not straight or level; twisted to one side
core_image: 被撞歪后懒得扶正的相框
scene: 风把门牌吹歪了，路牌也歪在一边，邮差仍能认出地址。The wind left the sign hanging askew over the shop door.
sceneCN: 这里 askew 是「歪斜地」（第 1 个义项：不正、偏向一边）；句意是风把招牌吹得歪挂在店门上。

derivatives.zh: 由形容词加名词后缀构成，义为「歪斜（罕用）」
同根词（去 a- 前缀），义为「使偏斜；偏态」

senses.title: Twisted to one side
senses.definition: turned or tilted to one side instead of being straight or level
senses.definitionCN: 偏向一侧而非端正平直
senses.example: Her glasses sat askew after the fall.
senses.why: The prefix a- marks a state, and the old word skew meant turned aside, so askew is the state of being crooked.
senses.whyCN: 前缀 a- 表状态，古词 skew 意为偏向，askew 即「处于歪斜状态」。

senses.title: Out of order or wrong
senses.definition: disordered or not as it should be
senses.definitionCN: 杂乱无章或偏离应有状态
senses.example: The audit revealed accounts gone badly askew.
senses.exampleCN: 审计发现账目严重错乱。
senses.why: When a line or plan no longer aligns, the crookedness becomes figurative disorder.
senses.whyCN: 当直线或计划不再对齐，歪斜便引申为比喻性的紊乱。

intro.en: Askew joins a- (in a state of) with skew, from Old French esquerrer or a Germanic source meaning to turn aside.
intro.cn: askew 由 a-（处于…状态）加 skew 构成，skew 源自古法语 esquerrer或日耳曼语词源，意为「偏向」。

items.en: A Germanic root meaning to shun or turn aside fed the Romance forms; the exact path is generally reconstructed.
items.cn: 意为「躲避、偏向」的日耳曼词根进入罗曼语；具体路径一般认为如此重构。

items.en: Esquerrer meant to escape or turn aside.
items.cn: 古法语 esquerrer 意为逃开、偏向。

items.en: Skew appeared meaning oblique or slanting.
items.cn: 中古英语 skew 意为斜的。

items.en: Askew was formed on the pattern of a + word for a state, like astray.
items.cn: 十六至十七世纪按 a + 状态词的格式构成 askew，类似 astray。

items.en: Modern English uses it for anything crooked, from hats to schedules.
items.cn: 现代英语用于一切歪斜之物，从帽子到日程。

note.en: Askew is the everyday crooked word; skew is its technical verb and adjective in statistics.
note.cn: askew 是日常的「歪斜」词；skew 则是统计学中的专业动词与形容词。

entries.definition: sideways with suspicion; similar shape, possibly related
entries.definitionCN: 斜眼地；怀疑地（形似，或相关）

entries.definition: away from the right path, built with the same a-
entries.definitionCN: 误入歧途的（同用 a- 构词）

entries.definition: the state of being askew; skewness is the standard noun
entries.definitionCN: 歪斜（罕用；标准名词为 skewness）

entries.definition: same a- pattern, arms bent outward
entries.definitionCN: 双手叉腰的（同 a- 构词格式）

normalIntro.en: Say a-screw: a picture frame with one loose screw hangs askew.
normalIntro.cn: 谐音「额斯柯」→「额螺丝松」：螺丝一松，画框就歪（askew）。

normal.en: a- + skew: in a crooked state.
same pattern as astray, astir, akimbo.
skew remains in statistics: skewed data.
normal.cn: skew 留在统计学中：偏态数据。

normal.en: use hang askew for objects, go askew for plans.
normal.cn: 物体用 hang askew，计划用 go askew。

abstract.en: Picture books stacked carelessly, edges sliding.
abstract.cn: 想象随意堆放、边缘滑移的书。

abstract.en: Feel a plan slipping out of alignment day by day.
abstract.cn: 体会计划日渐偏离轨道的感觉。

abstract.en: See a crooked tie in a mirror before an interview.
abstract.cn: 看见面试前镜中歪斜的领带。

examples.en: The storm left awnings hanging askew down the street.
examples.cn: 暴风雨过后，街上的遮阳篷都歪挂着。

examples.en: Everything went askew when the keynote speaker canceled.
examples.cn: 主讲人一取消，一切都乱了套。

examples.en: He wore his beret deliberately askew.

dict_mnemonic.text: 「额斯柯」——额的螺丝松了，框架全歪，正是 askew 的歪斜。

root: a-（古英语前缀，表状态）+ skew（源自古法语 esquerrer「偏向」，可上溯日耳曼词根），义为「处于歪斜状态」。

sensesIntro.en: Physical crookedness stretches into figurative disorder.
sensesIntro.cn: 物理的歪斜延伸为比喻的错乱。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a picture frame tilted one degree off level
core.cn: 核心意象：偏离水平一度角的画框

intro.en: The a- prefix pattern creates adverbs and adjectives of state from older words.
intro.cn: a- 前缀格式由古旧词根构成表状态的副词与形容词。

latinIntro.en: The root entered English partly through French, so Latin cognates are indirect at best.
latinIntro.cn: 词根部分经法语进入英语，拉丁同源词至多是间接的。
